script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let ability be a smart-weighted move of executer.
If the id of the move labelled "koduka_ability" on executer is not ability, then executer uses ability and stop.
Executer uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityTag: "koduka_poison", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect, conditions: {anyCanHit: true, targetType: game:Conf.ENEMY_BUILTIN_MULTIPLE_TARGET_TYPE.SAME_CAN_HIT}}].
